signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Set up a manager account and start scheduling your team
signup.emailHint: You will use this address to sign in.
signup.passwordHint: Minimum 8 characters, not entirely numeric, and not similar to your name or email.
signup.agree: By creating an account you agree to our {terms} and {privacy}.
signup.employeesNote: Employees do not sign up here — your manager creates your account and gives you your password.

twoFactorLogin.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactorLogin.subtitleApp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app
twoFactorLogin.subtitleRecovery: Enter one of your recovery codes
twoFactorLogin.recoveryHint: Each recovery code works only once.
twoFactorLogin.useRecovery: Lost your phone? Use a recovery code

privacy.title: Privacy & my data
privacy.subtitle: What PlanShift holds about your account, and your GDPR rights over it.
privacy.holdManager: Your name, email, employee ID and role, your profile picture and bio, your friends, when you were last online, the language you use, and the shifts you have created.
privacy.holdEmployee: Your name, email, employee ID and role, your profile picture and bio, your friends, when you were last online, the language you use, plus your shift assignments and the days you have marked yourself unavailable.
privacy.holdMore: See the full {policy} for why each piece is collected and who can see it.
privacy.requestText: Download everything above as a single JSON file - readable in any text editor or spreadsheet tool that imports JSON. We also email you a confirmation so you know if a copy of your data was ever downloaded without you.
privacy.deleteManager: Permanently deletes your account. If you've created shifts still on the schedule, reassign or remove them first - the schedule keeps a record of who created a published shift, so it can't be deleted out from under it.
privacy.deleteEmployee: Permanently deletes your account, your shift assignments and your unavailability records.
privacy.deleteFinal: This cannot be undone and there is no archive copy. A confirmation email is sent once it's done.
privacy.modalText: This permanently deletes your account, your shift assignments and your unavailability records. There is no undo and no archive copy - see the {policy} (section 4) for exactly what that means.

employeeShifts.hint: Click a free future day to mark it unavailable.

shifts.stale: Someone else just changed or deleted this shift, so saving will be refused. Close and reopen it to see the latest version.

team.empty: No employees yet. Add your first employee to start assigning shifts.
team.resetPasswordMessage: Are you sure you want to reset the password for:

team.deleteUserMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this user?
team.deleteEmployeeMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this employee?
team.deleteUserNote: This will remove the user and their assignments.
team.deleteEmployeeNote: This will remove the employee and their assignments.
team.passwordNote: A password is generated automatically and shown {once} after creation.
team.credentialsNote: This password is shown only once. Copy and share it securely.
team.deletePositionNote: A position still required by a shift cannot be deleted.

profile.noBio: No bio yet. {link} so people know who you are.

friends.noSentRequests: No requests waiting for an answer.

settings.title: Account settings
settings.subtitle: Your profile, picture, password, language and sign-in security.
settings.privacyLink: To download or delete your data, see {link}.
settings.avatarHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to {size} MB. It is cropped to a square; without one, your initials are shown.
settings.avatarTooBig: The picture must be {size} MB or smaller.
settings.emailHint: You sign in with this address.
settings.bioHint: Up to 300 characters, shown on your profile.
settings.currentPasswordHint: Only needed to change your email.
settings.languageHint: PlanShift, the emails it sends you and your notifications use this language.
settings.twoFactorIntro: After your password, signing in will also take a 6-digit code from an authenticator app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or Authy. Someone who learns your password still can't get in.
settings.scanStep: 1. Scan this QR code with an authenticator app.
settings.qrAlt: QR code that adds PlanShift to an authenticator app
settings.manualKey: Can't scan it? Type this key into the app instead:
settings.codeStep: 2. Enter the 6-digit code the app now shows.
settings.enabledSince: Signing in takes a code from your authenticator app. On since {date}.
settings.confirmItsYou: To turn it off or get new recovery codes, confirm it's you.
settings.codeOrRecovery: Code from your app, or a recovery code
settings.codesText: If you lose your phone, each code signs you in once. Keep them somewhere safe, such as a password manager. They are shown only now.
